blocks.text: Boarding and reception with welcome drinks and refined appetizers. We begin our navigation towards the legendary Rio Negro. Enjoy a gourmet lunch on board before visiting the meeting of the waters and the January Ecological Park. At dusk, explore the igapós on a canoe trip. We end the day with an elegant dinner on board, followed by sailing towards the heart of the Rio Negro.
